reviews.text: I’ve been taking this glutathione supplement consistently and noticed a gradual improvement in my skin’s clarity and overall brightness. The results are not instant, but with regular use my complexion looks more even and healthy. It’s gentle on the stomach and easy to include in a daily routine, which is important for long-term use. I also noticed less dullness and fatigue in my skin. This works best when taken consistently alongside good hydration and skincare habits.
reviews.zh: 我一直持續服用呢款谷胱甘肽補充劑，留意到皮膚清透度同整體亮度慢慢改善。效果唔係即時見到，但係經常服用，膚色睇落更加均勻、健康。佢對腸胃溫和，容易融入日常，對長期使用好重要。我亦留意到皮膚暗啞同疲倦感都少咗。如果同時保持足夠水分同良好嘅護膚習慣，效果會最好。

reviews.text: I have really sensitive skin ans I breakout a lot. I have been taking this collagen for exactly a month now, and my skin has improved so much. I have had zero breakouts since I started. Also, I had a C-section 5 months ago and was in pain. Within the month, all the lingering pain has vanished. I am so glad I invested in this.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好敏感，又成日爆痘。我食呢款膠原蛋白啱啱一個月，皮膚改善咗好多。由開始食到而家，我一次都冇爆痘。另外，我五個月前剖腹產，當時好痛。過咗一個月，所有殘留嘅痛楚都消失咗。我好高興買咗呢款。

reviews.text:
I have used the BOTO glutathione supplement for a month now and I can genuinely say it works in revitalizing and brightening the skin from the inside out. I'm a medium complexion Indian girl so for me this is a big YES for my skin especially since I suffer with hyperpigmentation and scarring. 

This is literally the last sachet from my first box, literally waiting one my second order.
reviews.zh:
我用咗 BOTO 谷胱甘肽補充劑一個月，我可以真心咁講，佢由內而外有助恢復活力同提亮皮膚。我係中等膚色嘅印度女仔，所以對我嚟講係大大嘅讚，尤其係因為我有色素沉澱同疤痕嘅問題。

呢個正正係我第一盒嘅最後一包，所以而家正等緊我第二次訂單。

reviews.text: This supplement drink is really amazing. It has glutathione, vitamin c, collagen, biotin and 17 types of hyaluronic acid, with all of these ingredients it really helped with digestive health and overall skin health. It really did what it promised. My skin is glowing, clearer , softer and diminished my mild hyperpigmentation on my cheeks now it’s gone. This product is totally worth buying! I highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 呢款補充飲品真係好正。佢含有谷胱甘肽、維他命 C、膠原蛋白、生物素同 17 種透明質酸，有咗呢啲成分，真係幫助消化健康同整體皮膚健康。佢真係做到佢所承諾嘅效果。我嘅皮膚變得有光澤、更加清透、更加柔軟，我面頰上嘅輕微色素沉澱而家已經冇咗。呢款絕對值得買！我強烈推薦。

reviews.text: I am currently taking this supplement and am very close to runing out. I have really enjoyed this product as it contains glutathione, biotin and collagen which is really convenient, it has given me a glow and has helped boost my confidence. I would recommend this product as it contains 3 super ingredients that work together to give you a more radiant and balanced appearance.
reviews.zh: 我而家正在食呢款補充劑，快食完啦。我好享受呢款產品，因為佢含有谷胱甘肽、生物素同膠原蛋白，真係好方便，令我有光澤，亦幫我提升咗自信。我會推薦呢款，因為佢有三種出色成分，可以一齊發揮作用，令你外觀更加有光采、更加平衡。

reviews.text:
This supplement is like an all-in-one beauty boost! It’s packed with glutathione, collagen, and biotin, which are all super important for your skin, hair, and nails. After using it for a while, I noticed my skin looking brighter and my hair growing stronger. The low molecular collagen is great because it absorbs really well, so you can really feel the benefits.

I love it because

 • My skin looks more radiant and even.
 • Helps strengthen my hair and nails.
 • Easy to take and gives noticeable results.
reviews.zh:
呢款補充劑就好似一站式嘅美容加強劑！入面有谷胱甘肽、膠原蛋白同生物素，對皮膚、頭髮同指甲都好重要。用咗一段時間之後，我留意到皮膚更加有光澤，頭髮生長得更加強韌。低分子膠原蛋白好好，因為吸收得好好，所以你真係可以感受到效果。

我鍾意佢嘅原因係

 • 我嘅皮膚睇落更加有光采、更加均勻。
 • 幫助加強頭髮同指甲。
 • 容易食用，效果明顯。

reviews.text:
within the first few uses, I noticed my skin felt more hydrated and had a subtle glow. The real changes came later and I think with frequent long-time use it’ll get more effective, my skin appears firmer especially in the neck area and the overall tone of my skin became more even. 
My complexion looks brighter and more radiant, it also seemed to help with my mild hyperpigmentation I got from hormonal acne, that I struggled to get rid of all these years, it made the spots less visible.
If you’re looking to invest in your skin’s long time health and are looking to become serious about skincare, I do recommend this product.
reviews.zh:
頭幾次用嘅時候，我覺得皮膚感覺更加水潤，亦有少少光澤。真正嘅改變係之後先出現，我諗如果長期經常使用，效果會更好。我嘅皮膚睇落更加緊緻，特別係頸部位置，膚色亦都變得更加均勻。
我嘅膚色睇落更加亮白、更加有光采，佢亦似乎幫助咗我因為荷爾蒙痘留低嘅輕微色素沉澱，令斑點冇咁明顯。我多年嚟都好難去除呢啲嘢。
如果你想投資自己皮膚嘅長遠健康，並且認真護膚，我會推薦呢款產品。

reviews.text: This skin, hair supplement drink is a very pleasant citrusy flavour which showed amazing results in just a less than two week daily intake. Brightened up complexion, I even had regular bowel motions. I also noticed that discolouration under eyes was reduced even so I work during the night for 12 hours; 48 hours a week. Definitely repurchase soon!
reviews.zh: 呢款皮膚同頭髮補充飲品有非常討好嘅柑橘味，每日飲用唔夠兩個星期，效果已經好驚人。膚色亮咗，我仲有排便規律。我亦留意到，我夜晚工作，每次 12 小時，每星期 48 小時，但眼周色素沉澱都減少咗。好快會再買！
